Videos of Siya Goyal and Ketan Agarwal surface amid murder probe

Amid the ongoing investigation into Ketan Agarwal's alleged murder, videos involving Siya Goyal have surfaced. One video shows Agarwal dancing with Goyal's family at an event, while another, purportedly from December 2025, shows Goyal in a pub. Goyal's father stated he would have reconsidered the marriage if he had known about her relationship with Agarwal.
